prompt: Which is an ADVANTAGE of group incentives?
explanation: Group advantages: performance measures are easier to develop · greater cohesion. The disadvantages are free riders (which lead to turnover) and discomfort with others influencing your pay.
source: MC Bank #91 · Question Bank PDF p. 11; key p. 19

prompt: The free-rider effect in group incentives can lead to:

prompt: In most situations, incentive pay should:
explanation: Commission-only roles replace traditional pay, but usually incentives complement it. The time horizon for goals should be attainable and realistic.
